newsitem.title: UK: Laing, Serco favoured for UK deal.
newsitem.headline: Laing, Serco favoured for UK deal.

text.p: The government has chosen Laser, a consortium of John Laing Plc and Serco Plc, as the preferred bidder for a 300 million stg private finance initiative deal to build new facilities for the National Physical Laboratory, Science Minister John Battle said on Tuesday.
Battle said the 25-year contract for the Teddington, Middlesex based facility would "provide a new suite of laboratories for one of our great scientific institutions".
"It will allow NPL to enter the millennium equipped to maintain its world class standing," he said in a written parliamentary answer.
Serco currently operates the National Physical Laboratory, (NPL) which provides measurement standards for industry, on behalf of the government.
Battle said the deal is the first to be approved under the PFI since the government reformed the initiative last month.
